import Mathlib.Algebra.MonoidAlgebra.Degree
import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.Eval
import Mathlib.Order.ConditionallyCompleteLattice.Finset
import Mathlib.Basic.Real.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Finsupp.Weight
import Mathlib.RingTheory.MvPowerSeries.NoZeroDivisors
import Mathlib.Tactic
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.RingDivision
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Taylor
namespace IndexUniqueMathlib151
universe u
variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
#check_failure Roth.index_unique
#check @Polynomial.rootMultiplicity_eq_natTrailingDegree
#check @Polynomial.taylor_apply
#check @Polynomial.natTrailingDegree_eq_support_min'
#check @Polynomial.natTrailingDegree_le_of_ne_zero
#check @AddMonoidAlgebra.infDegree

theorem minimumSupport (P : Polynomial R) (r : ℕ) :
    sInf ((fun n : ℕ ↦ (n : ℝ) / r) '' (P.support : Set ℕ)) =
      (P.natTrailingDegree : ℝ) / r := by
  by_cases hP : P = 0
  · subst P
    simp
  · apply le_antisymm
    · apply csInf_le (P.support.finite_toSet.image (fun n : ℕ ↦ (n : ℝ) / r)).bddBelow
      exact Set.mem_image_of_mem _ (Polynomial.mem_support_iff.mpr
        (Polynomial.coeff_natTrailingDegree_ne_zero.mpr hP))
    · refine le_csInf ((Polynomial.support_nonempty.mpr hP).to_set.image _) ?_
      rintro _ ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
        (by exact_mod_cast Polynomial.natTrailingDegree_le_of_mem_supp n hn) (Nat.cast_nonneg r)

theorem taylorMinimum (P : Polynomial R) (a : R) (r : ℕ) :
    sInf ((fun n : ℕ ↦ (n : ℝ) / r) '' ((Polynomial.taylor a P).support : Set ℕ)) =
      (P.rootMultiplicity a : ℝ) / r := by
  rw [minimumSupport, Polynomial.taylor_apply, Polynomial.rootMultiplicity_eq_natTrailingDegree]

theorem existingReaim (P : Polynomial R) (a : R) :
    (P.comp (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C a)).natTrailingDegree = P.rootMultiplicity a :=
  Polynomial.rootMultiplicity_eq_natTrailingDegree.symm

#print axioms minimumSupport
#print axioms taylorMinimum
#print axioms existingReaim
end IndexUniqueMathlib151

namespace IndexUniqueInfDegree151
universe u
variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
#check_failure Roth.index_unique
#check @Finset.min_eq_inf_withTop
#check @WithTop.untopD_coe
#check @Finset.coe_inf'
#check @Finset.inf'_eq_csInf_image

theorem trailingInf (P : Polynomial R) :
    AddMonoidAlgebra.infDegree (fun n : ℕ ↦ (n : ℕ∞)) P.toFinsupp =
      P.trailingDegree := by
  rw [Polynomial.trailingDegree, Finset.min_eq_inf_withTop]
  rfl

theorem rootInf (P : Polynomial R) (a : R) :
    (AddMonoidAlgebra.infDegree (fun n : ℕ ↦ (n : ℕ∞))
      (P.comp (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C a)).toFinsupp).toNat = P.rootMultiplicity a := by
  rw [trailingInf]
  exact Polynomial.rootMultiplicity_eq_natTrailingDegree.symm

theorem finsetBridge {ι : Type u} (s : Finset ι) (w : ι → ℝ) :
    (s.inf (fun d ↦ (w d : WithTop ℝ))).untopD 0 =
      sInf (w '' (s : Set ι)) := by
  classical
  rcases s.eq_empty_or_nonempty with h | h
  · subst s
    simp
  · change (s.inf (WithTop.some ∘ w)).untopD 0 = _
    rw [← Finset.coe_inf' h w, Finset.inf'_eq_csInf_image]
    rfl

theorem realInfSupport (P : Polynomial R) (r : ℕ) :
    (AddMonoidAlgebra.infDegree (fun n : ℕ ↦ (((n : ℝ) / (r : ℝ) : ℝ) : WithTop ℝ))
      P.toFinsupp).untopD 0 = (P.natTrailingDegree : ℝ) / r := by
  change (P.support.inf (fun n : ℕ ↦ (((n : ℝ) / (r : ℝ) : ℝ) : WithTop ℝ))).untopD 0 = _
  rw [finsetBridge, IndexUniqueMathlib151.minimumSupport]

theorem realRootInf (P : Polynomial R) (a : R) (r : ℕ) :
    (AddMonoidAlgebra.infDegree (fun n : ℕ ↦ (((n : ℝ) / (r : ℝ) : ℝ) : WithTop ℝ))
      (Polynomial.taylor a P).toFinsupp).untopD 0 = (P.rootMultiplicity a : ℝ) / r := by
  rw [realInfSupport, Polynomial.taylor_apply,
    Polynomial.rootMultiplicity_eq_natTrailingDegree]

#print axioms trailingInf
#print axioms rootInf
#print axioms finsetBridge
#print axioms realInfSupport
#print axioms realRootInf
end IndexUniqueInfDegree151

@Polynomial.rootMultiplicity_eq_natTrailingDegree : ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {p : Polynomial R} {t : R},
  Polynomial.rootMultiplicity t p = (p.comp (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C t)).natTrailingDegree

@Polynomial.taylor_apply : ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (r : R) (f : Polynomial R),
  (Polynomial.taylor r) f = f.comp (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C r)

@Polynomial.natTrailingDegree_eq_support_min' : ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] {p : Polynomial R} (h : p ≠ 0),
  p.natTrailingDegree = p.support.min' ⋯

@Polynomial.natTrailingDegree_le_of_ne_zero : ∀ {R : Type u_1} {n : ℕ} [inst : Semiring R] {p : Polynomial R},
  p.coeff n ≠ 0 → p.natTrailingDegree ≤ n

@AddMonoidAlgebra.infDegree : {R : Type u_1} →
  {A : Type u_2} →
    {T : Type u_3} →
      [inst : Semiring R] → [inst_1 : SemilatticeInf T] → [OrderTop T] → (A → T) → AddMonoidAlgebra R A → T
@Finset.min_eq_inf_withTop : ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : LinearOrder α] (s : Finset α), s.min = s.inf WithTop.some
@WithTop.untopD_coe : ∀ {α : Type u_1} (d x : α), WithTop.untopD d ↑x = x

@Finset.coe_inf' : ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : SemilatticeInf α] {s : Finset β} (H : s.Nonempty)
  (f : β → α), ↑(s.inf' H f) = s.inf (WithTop.some ∘ f)

@Finset.inf'_eq_csInf_image : ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [inst : ConditionallyCompleteLattice α] (s : Finset ι)
  (H : s.Nonempty) (f : ι → α), s.inf' H f = sInf (f '' ↑s)
